description: This file defines a report for item price stock, including functions to generate report columns, fetch data, and map prices, used within the ERPNext framework.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Returns the column definitions for the report.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and returns the report data based on filters.

methods.name: get_item_price_qty_data
methods.description: Retrieves item price and quantity data, applying filters.

methods.name: get_price_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping of item prices for buying or selling prices.
